Bill.BriefDescription: Granting authority to the secretary of health to conduct inspections of massage business establishments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to administrative inspections of massage businessestablishments; and adding a new section to chapter 18.108 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 18.108 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: For the purposes of ascertaining violations of this chapter andchapter 18.130 RCW the secretary shall have the authority to inspectthe premises of any business establishment during hours such businessis open. If the secretary is denied access to any premises orestablishment advertising or offering massage the secretary may applyto any court of competent jurisdiction for a warrant authorizing accessto such premises or establishment for such purposes. The court may,upon such application, issue a warrant for the purpose requested.
